name: adrv
description: Visual ADR dependency graph with a Tailwind UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @adrv/core && npm run build -w @adrv/web && npm run build -w @adrv/cli
scripts.start: npm run build -w @adrv/core && npm run build -w @adrv/web && cargo run --release --target-dir ./target -- serve --root ./docs/adr --port 8080 --web ./packages/web/dist
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @adrv/core && npm run typecheck -w @adrv/web && npm run typecheck -w @adrv/cli
